criteria: The child draws one recognisable favourite object, place, animal, or activity.

The child can name or briefly describe what was drawn.

criteria: The drawing represents a recognisable event or setting from a story the child knows.
The scene includes at least one character and one relevant action or detail.
The child can briefly retell or explain the chosen scene.
responseRubric.scoring: Assess story representation and explanation, not artistic skill or a single model answer.
